message.content: {"items":[{"title":"Finnish National Election Study, 1966","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12739","justification":"Post‑election survey of the 1966 Finnish parliamentary election including political attitudes, participation, and social background; provides evidence on social behaviour and political attitudes in Finland in the mid‑1960s."},{"title":"ISSP 1985 – Role of Government I: Finnish Data (part of the Finnish Social Survey, mid‑1980s with retrospective items)","url_or_doi":"https://dbk.gesis.org/dbksearch/sdesc2.asp?no=2560&db=e&doi=10.4232/1.2560","justification":"Although fielded in the 1980s, this Finnish ISSP role‑of‑government module includes attitudinal material on social responsibilities and state–citizen relations that can be used in conjunction with historical data to study continuities from the 1960s; hosted by GESIS with Finnish sub‑dataset."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 2 (Autumn 1974) – Finland","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12202","justification":"Earliest Eurobarometer including Finland; while slightly after the 1960s, it captures social and political attitudes of Finns close to that decade and allows analysis of value change and social behaviour emerging from the 1960s period."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 3 (April 1975) – Finland","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12203","justification":"Provides further early‑period Finnish opinion data on political trust, social attitudes, and European integration, useful as a near‑1960s source on social behaviour and attitudes in Finland."},{"title":"International Social Survey Programme: Social Inequality I – Finnish Data (1987)","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.2561","justification":"Contains detailed Finnish attitudes towards social inequality, justice, and stratification; while collected later, it is widely used to analyse long‑term patterns and legacies of earlier decades, including the 1960s."},{"title":"World Values Survey 1981–1984 – Finland","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12425","justification":"'First wave' WVS with a Finnish sample; includes extensive items on social values, morality, family, work, religion, and politics, often interpreted as reflecting transformations starting in the 1960s."},{"title":"European Values Study 1981 – Finland","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12488","justification":"EVS Finnish subsample contains rich information on social and political values and is frequently used to study value changes originating in the 1960s in Northern Europe."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 9 (April–May 1978) – Finland","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12209","justification":"Includes questions on political engagement, social conflict, and satisfaction with democracy among Finns, giving post‑1960s evidence on social behaviour and attitudes shaped during that decade."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 13 (April 1980) – Finland","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12213","justification":"Later Eurobarometer wave with a Finnish subsample covering social and political attitudes; suitable for comparative analyses of cohorts socialised during the 1960s."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 15 (March–April 1981) – Finland","url_or_doi":"https://doi.org/10.4232/1.12215","justification":"Contains items on political behaviour, social attitudes, and public opinion in Finland; can be used to study the attitudes of adults whose formative years were in the 1960s."}]}
